mapper.select:
SELECT ifnull(sum(case when apply_type = 0 then 1 else 0 end),0) as leaveCount, ifnull(sum(case when apply_type = 1 then 1 else 0 end),0) as workOverCount, ifnull(sum(case when apply_type = 2 then 1 else 0 end),0) as fieldCount, ${query.queryType} AS queryType FROM copy_info ci
AND ci.user_id = #{query.userId}
